lines.t: **Verse 1**
Everybody's running after neon skies,
Trading hearts away for another disguise.
Every empty promise looks gold,
But underneath it's broken and cold.
I don't want to follow lies.
I don't want to walk in the haze.
If the whole world's turning from the Light,
I'll still choose Your way.
**Pre-Chorus**
The louder they speak, the less I hear.
Your quiet voice is crystal clear.
When the smoke begins to rise,
You're the truth in my eyes.
**Chorus**
The world is covered by a veil of gray,
Hidden beneath all the words they say.
The lights are shining, but nothing feels real,
They're chasing things that can never heal.
I don't want to walk in their empty ways,
I don't want to be lost in the haze.
I'll turn my eyes from the fading view,
Because YahuShua, I'm choosing You.
**Verse 2**
The world is lost inside a painted dream,
Calling broken chains another kind of freedom.
They reach for stars that disappear by dawn,
While You have been the same all along.
The world has grown dark and dim,
But You have never changed.
Every shadow points me back
To the One who knows my name.
**Pre-Chorus**
Every road they call alive
Only leaves the soul bone dry.
When the smoke begins to rise,
You're the truth in my eyes.
**Chorus**
The world is covered by a veil of gray,
Hidden beneath all the words they say.
The lights are shining, but nothing feels real,
They're chasing things that can never heal.
I don't want to walk in their empty ways,
I don't want to be lost in the haze.
I'll turn my eyes from the fading view,
Because YahuShua, I'm choosing You.
**Bridge**
When the lights burn out, You're still the flame.
When every voice has changed, You're still the same.
No turning back. No compromise.
I'll keep my eyes on You.
**Final Chorus**
The world is covered by a veil of gray,
Hidden beneath all the words they say.
The lights are shining, but nothing feels real,
They're chasing things that can never heal.
I don't want to walk in their empty ways,
I don't want to be lost in the haze.
I'll turn my eyes from the fading view,
Because YahuShua, I'm choosing You.
